entities.summary: Abram or Avraam Melnikov was a Russian Neoclassical architect associated with the late phase of the Empire style. His teachers at the Imperial Academy of Arts included Andreyan Zakharov. He graduated with a gold medal and went to further his studies in Italy. Melnikov became de facto Dean of the Academy in 1831 but was not officially appointed until 1843. Avraam Melnikov was a architects & engineers from Lomonosov (1784-08-10, Lomonosov–1854-01-13). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
